desc: The Rise Armament Super Sporting Trigger (SST) is a high-performing, cost-effective upgrade to replace mil-spec triggers. It has a clean break with a short reset and comes with anti-walk pins for installation. The triggers are manufactured and assembled in Rise Armament’s facility according to strict AS9100 aerospace requirements, which are more stringent than standard gun manufacturing requirements. They are backed by a lifetime guarantee through Rise Armament.
